explicit_answers.real_exception_after_artifact_creation_s: JSONDecodeError while reading the legacy monolithic artifact registry.
explicit_answers.component_function: ArtifactRegistryRepository.list invoked by ArtifactRegistryRepository.save during UniversalArtifactRegistryService.create.
explicit_answers.before_during_after_payload_hydration: After artifact content render and before artifact_created; not caused by media metadata policy.
explicit_answers.payload_shape: The artifact registry boundary received a corrupt legacy JSON file, while TaskRun payload refs were separate and valid enough to spill large ObservedEntity data.
explicit_answers.inline_large_payload_attempt: Legacy monolithic registry behaved as an unbounded inline projection and was 2GB.
explicit_answers.schema_mismatch: The registry storage contract treated a monolithic legacy projection as mandatory authority instead of a bounded projection.
explicit_answers.source_mismatch_resolution: R2.8 adds failure_source/result_builder_source separation in result outputs and exception context.
explicit_answers.artifact_failure_authority: artifact runtime exception boundary is failure_source; phase semantic completion policy may still build the terminal result.
explicit_answers.continue_or_stop_after_first_artifact_fa: Phase 1 stops after required first artifact creation failure; later artifacts are not evaluated until the first artifact terminalizes successfully.
explicit_answers.music_inventory_public_evaluation_condit: music_inventory is only evaluated if the artifact runtime reaches that logical artifact.
explicit_answers.lightweight_storage: new artifact records are written to sharded manifests and task_run artifact index; legacy registry is skipped when too large or invalid.

patch_plan: Make ArtifactRegistryRepository tolerate oversized/corrupt legacy artifact_registry.json.
Write new artifact manifests to data/artifacts/manifests/by_artifact and artifact_registry_index.json.
Do not overwrite or delete the 2GB legacy registry as part of normal artifact creation.
Keep UniversalArtifactRegistryService task_run artifact index as endpoint projection source.
Add exception_context with stack_trace_ref for future artifact runtime exceptions.
Preserve R2.7 terminality guard and conservative Speaker Truth.

root_cause_confirmed.cause: legacy monolithic artifact_registry.json was 2147483647 bytes and invalid JSON; create/save attempted to parse it before writing a new artifact

patch_summary.artifact_registry: sharded by_artifact manifests plus lightweight artifact_registry_index; oversized/invalid legacy registry skipped with diagnostic instead of parsed on writes
patch_summary.exception_capture: artifact creation exceptions get sanitized context and stack payload refs
patch_summary.artifact_worker_terminality: finished_at populated by guard; queue/store reconciliation can terminalize artifact_creation_started stalls with artifact-specific reason
patch_summary.cvl: frontiers added for unreadable legacy registry and payload hydration boundary
